item.title: What Cloudflare Doesn't Tell You
item.description:
📝 One of my biggest problems with this is the fact that Cloudflare doesn't do enough to notify website administrators about these issues. The Cloudflare dashboard should notify you about each of these issues where Cloudflare is following better practices than your origin server, without website administrators having to dig through and specifically look for this information. Even when website administrators invest in deploying IPv6 on their origin servers, Cloudflare still prioritizes IPv4.
